VinomTV Subscription Plans & Pricing 2027: Monthly, 3-Month, 6-Month & Annual Plans

VinomTV offers prepaid IPTV subscriptions with four main term lengths and packages for up to six simultaneous connections. The right choice depends on three things: how long you want the subscription, how many screens will stream at the same time, and whether the service performs properly on your own device and internet connection.

This buyer guide breaks down VinomTV pricing and subscription plans without repeating the same claims across multiple sections. It covers prices, connections, included features, content categories, device compatibility, internet requirements, free trial, billing, activation, renewal, refunds and the best plan for different types of users.

Quick Answer: How Much Does VinomTV Cost?

For one simultaneous connection, the current published prices are:

  • 1 Month: $15
  • 3 Months: $40
  • 6 Months: $60
  • 12 Months: $120

The 6-month and 12-month one-connection plans currently both equal $10 per month. VinomTV also lists plans with 1 to 6 simultaneous connections. New customers should test the free trial before committing to a longer prepaid period.

Important Definitions Before Comparing Plans

IPTV subscription: an account that delivers television and on-demand content through an internet connection.

Connection: one active stream at a time. Two connections allow two simultaneous streams.

VOD: video on demand, including movies and series available to select when listed in the catalogue.

EPG: Electronic Program Guide, used to show programme schedules in compatible players.

M3U / Xtream Codes: common IPTV login formats. M3U normally uses a playlist URL; Xtream-style login separates the server, username and password.

What Is VinomTV?

VinomTV is an IPTV subscription service marketed to viewers in the USA, Canada and other regions. Its website describes live TV, movies, series, sports and PPV categories, along with compatibility across Firestick, Smart TV, Android, Apple TV, MAG, PC and mobile devices.

VinomTV website interface showing the service overview, pricing CTA and free-trial CTA.

The site separates its main service information from subscription pricing, the channel list, free trial and device setup guidance. That gives buyers a practical path: review the service, check pricing, verify the content they need and test compatibility before choosing a longer plan.

Internet Speed Requirements for HD, FHD & 4K

VinomTV’s current support guidance recommends at least 15 Mbps for HD and 25 Mbps or more for 4K. These figures are useful baselines for one stream, not guarantees of performance.

For multiple simultaneous connections, leave additional bandwidth available for each active stream and for other devices using the same home network. A wired Ethernet connection or stable 5 GHz Wi-Fi usually gives more consistent playback than a weak or congested wireless signal.

Use CasePractical Starting PointWhat Else Matters
HD stream15 Mbps+Stable Wi-Fi or Ethernet
4K stream25 Mbps+4K-capable device, player and source
Multiple streamsAdd headroom for each active streamTotal household bandwidth and router capacity

Recommended IPTV Players for VinomTV

The IPTV subscription and the player are separate parts of the setup. VinomTV’s guides reference several common player options, including TiviMate, IPTV Smarters, XCIPTV, VLC and Kodi, depending on device and login format.

  • TiviMate: popular on Android TV and Fire TV interfaces.
  • IPTV Smarters / XCIPTV: common choices for Xtream-style account logins on supported devices.
  • VLC: useful for testing accessible M3U streams on desktop.
  • Kodi: suitable for users who prefer a configurable media-center interface.

Do not buy a player upgrade until you know it supports your device and the login format supplied with your account. See the VinomTV IPTV player comparison for setup considerations.

Payment, Activation, Renewal & Refunds

Payment and Activation

VinomTV’s current pricing guidance describes the plans as prepaid. After purchase, activation and access details are delivered by email. If the message does not appear in the inbox, check spam or junk folders.

  1. Choose the subscription length.
  2. Select the required number of simultaneous connections.
  3. Complete the available checkout process.
  4. Check your email for account details.
  5. Install a compatible IPTV player.
  6. Enter the supplied login information exactly as provided.

Renewal

The current pricing guidance states that plans do not automatically rebill. When the prepaid term ends, access stops unless the customer chooses to renew or order another plan.

Refunds

VinomTV’s current support page states a 7-day money-back guarantee and directs customers to the official refund policy for details. Read the current terms before ordering, because eligibility and conditions can change.

Can You Upgrade or Change Your VinomTV Plan?

A customer may want to move from monthly to annual billing, increase the number of simultaneous connections or choose a different term at renewal. Because account-level changes can depend on billing status and the existing package, do not assume an upgrade is automatic.

Check the current pricing options and contact VinomTV support to confirm what can be changed on the existing account before making another payment.

VinomTV Customer Support

VinomTV’s official support page advertises 24/7 assistance through live chat and Telegram, with email/ticket support also available. Support is particularly relevant for account activation, player setup, login errors, buffering troubleshooting, plan changes and renewal questions.

VinomTV Pricing for USA & Canada Users

VinomTV markets the same core subscription structure to viewers in the USA and Canada. For buyers in either country, the practical decision is less about country-specific plan names and more about content availability, device compatibility, connection count and the sports or local channels you actually need.

USA and Canada viewers should use the trial to confirm the specific national, regional and sports channels they care about. Device timezone settings also matter for EPG accuracy, so the player should be configured for the user’s real local timezone.

Before You Buy: 7 Things to Check

  1. Use the free trial first.
  2. Verify the specific channels, languages and sports categories you need.
  3. Choose the correct number of simultaneous connections.
  4. Confirm your device and player compatibility.

  7. Review current pricing, renewal and refund terms before payment.

Common Buying Mistakes

  • Buying too many connections because you own many devices.
  • Choosing a 12-month plan before testing the service.
  • Confusing installed devices with simultaneous streams.
  • Using the wrong M3U or Xtream login format in the player.
  • Assuming every buffering issue comes from the provider without checking Wi-Fi, device and player performance.

Legal, Licensing & Content Availability Note

IPTV is a delivery technology. The legal status of specific programming depends on licensing rights, the provider, the content and the jurisdiction where it is viewed. Customers should check applicable local rules and confirm that the content they access is authorized for their location and intended use.

Channel names, sports events and VOD titles may also change over time because content availability is not permanently fixed by the subscription term.

Pricing Accuracy: What Can Change?

  • Subscription prices can change.
  • Promotional offers can start or end.
  • Connection packages can be revised.
  • Channel and VOD availability can change.
  • Trial and refund terms can be updated.

Use this guide for comparison, then verify the final price and current terms on the official VinomTV pages immediately before checkout.

Is VinomTV Worth the Price in 2027?

VinomTV’s pricing is most attractive when the buyer matches the term and connection count to actual usage. The 1-month plan keeps commitment low, while the 6-month plan currently offers the strongest balance for one-connection users because it reaches the same $10 monthly equivalent as the annual plan with a shorter prepaid period.

The 12-month plan is better suited to customers who have already tested the service and value the convenience of paying for a full year in advance.

A connection refers to one active stream at a time. Installing a player on multiple devices is different from streaming on all of them simultaneously.

Yes. Firestick and Fire TV are among the device types listed by VinomTV.

Which VinomTV plan is best for a new customer?

Use the free trial first. If you want to continue with the lowest paid commitment, the 1-month plan is the simplest starting point.

Which VinomTV plan offers the best balance of price and commitment?

For one connection, the 6-month plan currently reaches the same $10 monthly equivalent as the annual plan while requiring a shorter prepaid term.

Can I use VinomTV on multiple TVs?

Yes, but the number of TVs streaming at the same time must stay within the connection limit of the selected plan.

Is the longest VinomTV plan always the best choice?

No. The annual plan can be convenient for established users, but the 6-month plan currently has the same single-connection monthly equivalent with a smaller upfront commitment.
